correctness.rationale: PASS: Exactly the local minima of n-1 internal uniform-order gaps correspond to mutual pairs; endpoint *external* spacings are excluded. In an independent exponential coupling the indicators and Y_i=E_i I_i are 2-dependent, and W=Z/S with S Gamma(n+1,1) independent of normalized spacings. The on-site, neighboring and distance-two mixed covariance tables integrate exponential densities and sum to (64n+105)/2700 for Cov(R,Z); division by n+1 gives the asserted positive mixed moment. Local Y covariance gives exact Var(W) using E[S²]=(n+1)(n+2), and 2-dependent multivariate CLT/delta method yields covariance [[2/45,16/675],[16/675,44/1125]]. Independently enumerated all gap relative rank permutations for n=3..7, using conditional exact exponential order-statistic means, reproducing E[R], E[W], and covariance including small exceptions. The finite checks are not the general CLT proof.

value.rationale: PASS: Mutual nearest-neighbor pairs are canonical components of the one-dimensional nearest-neighbor graph, and their count and physical total extent are separately natural observables. The exact strictly positive mixed covariance, exact variance and nonzero limiting joint correlation quantify genuine simultaneous uncertainty and contrast with known negative component-vs-total-edge-length covariances; these new constants are useful without a broader family theorem.

limitations: Uniform iid points on one interval only; no arbitrary density, higher dimension, chordal circle or double-counted directed length.
